purpose: Verify fresh-clone regeneration when completed-run metadata are present but ignored raw output is absent. Software verification only; no generated data are used in the scientific report.
configuration_scope: Existing isolated fixture: 512 nodes, 0.002 years, one thread; production source unchanged.
setup: Use the existing short, coarse fixture produced by python3 scripts/smoke_pipeline.py; its outputs are excluded from scientific results.
Copy current src, tests, scripts, CMakeLists.txt and requirements.txt into a new isolated directory; copy the fixture configurations.
Reuse the installed generic FFTW dependency. Copy completed baseline metadata but omit fields.bin, history.csv, and checkpoint.bin.
Run the recorded simulate-only command in the isolated directory, allowing bootstrap to build and run the verification checks.
Check that old metadata are archived, the rerun exits successfully, and regenerated fields.bin and history.csv have the original fixture SHA-256 hashes.
